sentences.text: WRIT PETITION NO: 14040 OF 2025
ORDER:

Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that the petitioners are in possession and enjoyment of various extents of land which are abutting the road and the respondents vide a notification issued in the year 2022 proposed to acquire the lands of the petitioners, however, the notification was issued.

The some of the affected parties have filed W.P.No.151 of 2025 and this Court vide order dated 23.01.2025 disposed of the writ petition at the admission stage recording the written instructions of the Government Pleader appearing for the revenue department that the respondents shall follow the guide lines of G.O.Ms.No.562 Revenue (L.A) Department dated 13.11.2018.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that in the event the respondents adhere to the guidelines of G.O.Ms.No.562, the petitioners have no objection for parting with their land subject to respondents complying with the guidelines.
L'uJdfiSS HN, J W.P.No.l4040_2025 3.

The learned Government Pleader appearing for the respondents clearly concedes that the government is willing to comply with the directions of G.O.i\/ls.No.562.
4.
Recording the same, this writ petition is disposed of, of directing the respondents to comply with the guidelines G.O.Ms.No.562 Revenue (L.A) Department dated 13.11.2018.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.

opennyai_summary.facts: Learned counsel for the Petitioners submits that the petitioners are in possession and enjoyment of various extents of land which are abutting the road and the respondents vide a notification issued in the year 2022 proposed to acquire the lands of the petitioners, however, the notification was issued.
opennyai_summary.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that in the event the respondents adhere to the guidelines of G.O.Ms.No.562, the petitioners have no objection for parting with their land subject to respondents complying with the guidelines.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Recording the same, this writ petition is disposed of, of directing the respondents to comply with the guidelines G.O.Ms.No.562 Revenue (L.A) Department dated 13.11.2018.
There shall be no order as to costs.
